notes.title: Update on May 6,2018
notes.notes:
Contact Email: 891320470@qq.com if you have any questions about this game. Your questions  will be solved as soon as possible.

In this update, all the officers of  Sanguo appears in the big map when you start the game, and looking for their lost weapons. If you give the corresponding weapon, the officer will join your team immediately, without the needs of defeating his lord to recruit him. This makes the players to meet more officers in the beginning of  the game, and brings more possibilities for the game process.
Also, there are other changes:
1. A detailed map which describes the location of every city of Sanguo is added, when you use the key item "Sanguo Map" you can see it during the game.
2.  Key items, such as "Lun Yu", "Yi Jing" and "Shi Jing" are enabled to use multiple ones now, whici is more convenient.
3. The description of battle status will be shown when you use the key item "Property Detector".
4. The settings of Skills, Enemies, Items are changed to improve the game 
experience.
5. Part of the script in this game is improved, and  continuous Improvement will be made for this game.
